name: chatgpt2api
postCreateCommand: bash -c 'for i in $(seq 1 30); do docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; sleep 3; done; cd /workspaces/chatgpt2api && echo "{}" > config.json && docker compose up -d; for i in $(seq 1 40); do curl -fsS http://localhost:3000/ >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; sleep 5; done'
